description: AOO (Audio over OSC) is a lightweight peer-to-peer library for streaming audio and messages in real time over local networks or the public internet. It includes a Pure Data external and an embeddable C/C++ library.

research.notes: The project was previously hosted at https://git.iem.at/cm/aoo; the maintainer’s 2.0-pre4 announcement identifies the current issue tracker under the aoo/aoo namespace.
